exposure: scarring located within 1 cm of the sternal notch
cohort: The study included a total of 4238 patients who underwent thyroidectomy.
finding: Hypertrophic scar development was associated with younger age, male sex, higher body mass index, prominent sternocleidomastoid muscles, scarring located within 1 cm of the sternal notch, and a history of keloid development, with scar location and keloid history also affecting prognosis.
